hotspots.name: The Third Door
hotspots.description: No sign, no window, and a counter just inside that has been worn to a shine by people not making eye contact.

hotspots.name: The Papered Door
hotspots.description: Bills pasted six deep: a prizefight, a patent tonic, two missing persons, and a constabulary notice about the receipt of stolen goods that somebody has thoughtfully papered over.

hotspots.name: Churned Mud
hotspots.description: The alley never dries. Boot prints on top of boot prints, and a wheel rut deep enough to say that something heavy is carted through here regularly and at night.
